tei:titleStmt.tei:title: Amidah for Yom Tov Maariv, Shacharis and Minchah: You chose us from [among] all the peoples;

tei:availability.tei:p: Published by Sefaria under CC-BY, which Sefaria defines as Creative Commons Attribution 3.0.

tei:note.tei:p: All three pilgrimage festivals are alluded to in this prayer. “You chose us from among all peoples,” etc. refers to Pesach, when God redeemed us from Egypt and took us to Himself for a people. (See Exodus 6:7)
“You exalted us above all tongues” etc. refers to Shavuos when we received the Torah which sanctified us above all nations with its commandments.
We were drawn near to Him and His Name was proclaimed upon us on Sukkos with the עַנַנֵּי כָּבוֹד , the Divine clouds that hovered over Israel and signified God’s protection and forgiveness.
